Arch specific signal numbers, restorer mechanics and tag handling beyond the generic wrappers.
Multiprocessor interrupt delivery, ordering and synchronization beyond the inline wrappers.

findings.text: Restartable sequence identity record offers a combined 64 bit view that can also be addressed as separate processor and address space concurrency parts, accompanied by a distinct node number.
Slice control keeps a compact combined state also visible as enabled and granted subflags; a slice pairs that control with an expiration instant and a yielded marker.

When the feature is configured the per task restartable sequence record carries a user pointer with length and signature plus event, identity and optional slice subrecords; without configuration it collapses to an empty placeholder.
Address space concurrency identity reserves three high bits to distinguish unset, currently executing on a processor, and transitional conditions.
Per task concurrency entry pairs activity and current values with hash linkage; per processor current value record is isolated to its own cache line.

Process wide concurrency management groups a per processor table with mode and capacity, deferred work items, synchronization members, user linkage and usage accounting with cache line separation; without configuration both process and task records are empty.
Process wide concurrency updates are guarded by a low level spin primitive together with a sleeping mutual exclusion primitive, with explicit deferred update and user count fields.

Permitted filter creation flags are the combination of logging, listener, speculation allowance, thread synchronization variants and killable receive wait; descriptor addition sizing for version zero is 24 bytes and latest tracks that version.
Active filtering path checks a per thread work marker and only consults deeper evaluation when marked, otherwise allows; mode query returns the stored task mode value.
When filtering is unavailable permission always allows, strict entry and reference management do nothing, mode reports disabled, and control plus introspection helpers report invalid argument.
Enabled task filtering state holds a mode value with a filter reference count and filter pointer; without the feature both task state and filter collapse to empty placeholders.
System V task state keeps an undo list pointer when IPC is configured and otherwise nothing; shared memory task state keeps a list of attachments when configured and is empty otherwise.

Semaphore undo copy reports success without action and exit does nothing; without shared memory support attach reports unimplemented and exit plus task initialization are empty, otherwise initialization prepares the attachment list.

Kernel to kernel signal detail copy duplicates the full kernel record; export to user duplicates the kernel portion and clears the trailing extension area whose size is the difference between user and kernel record sizes.

Signal detail layout enumeration distinguishes kill, timer, polling, system call, child and realtime origins plus a fault family with trap number, machine check, bounds, protection key and performance subkinds.
Single signal removal and membership test adjust one based numbers to zero based indexing with a dedicated single word fast path and a word plus bit computation otherwise.

Emptiness is determined by OR across words and equality by word wise comparison for one, two and four word configurations with a build time failure otherwise; a single signal mask is a shift derived from its number.

Bulk set helpers provide union, intersection, difference and negation applied word wise with fallthrough across sizes, plus clear all and set all with optimized small size paths and generic memory fill otherwise.
Low word mask helpers set, clear and test bits in the first word; initialized forms load the first word from a mask or its complement while clearing or setting any remaining words.
Pending signal state initialization empties the set and prepares queue linkage; number validity is a range check against the maximum signal number.

Two reserved handler encodings mark kernel thread handling for all signals versus kernel originated signals; helpers install those encodings to avoid conversion to termination or silent drop, and disallow maps to ignore.

Membership classification applies only below the realtime base and tests bit presence; one mask isolates termination and stop, another the job control stop family, and another the continue, child, window change and urgent set.

Dump causing set covers abnormal termination faults and resource limit conditions plus a machine specific member that is zero when absent; code specific set covers faults, child, polling and system call origins; fatality excludes ignored and stop classes and requires default disposition; realtime bit construction uses a wide shift when available.
Alternate stack save transfers three current task fields to a user structure with fault labels; size validation always succeeds here and address untagging returns its input unchanged.

Kernel signal detail is a wrapper around a shared info layout; queued signal entries chain queue linkage with flags, detail and resource accounting; pending state pairs queue linkage with a set; action records handler, flags, optional restorer and mask with a kernel wrapper adding an arch restorer when present.
Legacy action layout orders handler, mask, flags and restorer distinctly; in flight delivery record pairs resolved action with detail and number.

One mid range bit marks immutable actions; user visible action flags combine child handling, info, alternate stack, restart, defer, reset, tag exposure and an arch piece that is either restorer support or zero.
When signal file descriptor support is present notification wakes the shared queue only if waiters exist; otherwise notification and cleanup are empty.

Remote call request bundles list linkage with a function pointer and opaque context with helpers to build and assign both members; node linkage carries a dual unsigned and atomic flag view plus optional source and destination identifiers on wide builds; call and predicate types distinguish void context callbacks from per processor boolean guards.

Cross call and deferred interrupt work encodings distinguish lock, pending, busy, lazy without interrupt, hard interrupt context and claimed combinations plus asynchronous, synchronous, interrupt work and wakeup types with a high nibble type mask.
Broadcast helpers delegate to a conditional masked primitive using the online set when no mask is given and a null predicate when no condition is given.

Multiprocessor rescheduling traces then delegates to arch handling; generic interrupt handling aliases to its single variant; boot identifier, processor identifier and stuck lock queries have debug and direct forms; current processor capture pairs preemption disable with identifier read and reenable on release; stop on this path does nothing.

Single processor configuration reports processor zero, turns remote invocation into a discarded call or a direct call on processor zero, leaves rescheduling, stop, kick, idle wake and pending checks empty or negative, and simplifies boot identity, mask allocation, initialization and stuck detection.

Per processor hotplug thread descriptor holds per processor task storage with list linkage, callbacks for run decision, main work, creation, setup, cleanup and parking transitions, a self parking marker and a name.

Disabled and single processor fallbacks can silently succeed while doing no work: filtering always allows, shared memory attach reports unimplemented, and remote calls drop their function without execution.
Each header defines a unique inclusion guard macro to prevent multiple inclusion.
